[05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-ai-skills/2026-10-01 - integrating-graphify-with-ai-skills-obsidian [ses_f08265ed8ffeskLquEm502BU5L].md:L09062] Let me stop the extraction, add Attachments to .graphifyignore, and restart. graphify caches completed chunks, so restarting should reuse the semantic cache (SHA256 cache) — the 31 completed chunks should be reused.
